items.title: Bitcoin now looks cheap by one measure after $1 billion in ETF outflows
items.teaser: Darkfost’s adjusted MVRV signal highlights lower valuation, while dated ETF withdrawals and an attributed SOPR reading leave recovery unconfirmed. Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the …

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
items.teaser: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
items.teaser: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

items.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
items.teaser: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.
